records.text: Owens said the prior episode mistakenly showed Bob Ferguson as Bob Flood, that Ferguson had nothing to do with the story, and that the image was removed.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We made a mistake and showed you a picture of a man that is actually not named Bob Flood at all. ... His name is actually Bob Ferguson. He's from Iowa. He has nothing to do with the story. It was genuinely a full blown mistake. I've actually reached out to him and I just deeply apologize. We wiped it from the episode, but many of you saw it before we actually did.

verification.notes: The source-scoped transcript shows Owens explicitly issuing a correction: she said the prior episode used a picture of Bob Ferguson while identifying it as Bob Flood, said Ferguson was unrelated to the story, and said the image had been wiped from the episode. An external transcript reproduces the correction. This verifies that Owens made the correction and removal claim; it does not independently audit the prior episode edit or Ferguson's identity.
